versos.hebraico: וְעָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְאָהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְכֹ֣ל׀ אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּתְבוּנָה֙ בָּהֵ֔מָּה לָדַ֣עַת לַעֲשֹׂ֔ת אֶֽת־כָּל־מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”
controles.kjv: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the Lord had commanded.
controles.livre: Fez, pois, Bezalel e Aoliabe, e todo homem sábio de coração, a quem o SENHOR deu sabedoria e inteligência para que soubessem fazer toda a obra do serviço do santuário, todas as coisas que havia mandado o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל־בְּצַלְאֵ֘ל וְאֶל־אָֽהֳלִיאָב֒ וְאֶל֙ כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה חָכְמָ֖ה בְּלִבּ֑וֹ כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֔וֹ לְקָרְבָ֥ה אֶל־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it:
controles.kjv: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
controles.livre: E Moisés chamou a Bezalel e a Aoliabe, e a todo homem sábio de coração, em cujo coração havia dado o SENHOR sabedoria, e a todo homem a quem seu coração lhe moveu a chegar-se à obra, para trabalhar nela;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְח֞וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כָּל־הַתְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִמְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑הּ וְ֠הֵם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥יו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר׃

controles.web: and they received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They brought yet to him freewill offerings every morning.
controles.kjv: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
controles.livre: E tomaram de diante de Moisés toda a oferta que os filhos de Israel haviam trazido para a obra do serviço do santuário, a fim de fazê-la. E eles lhe traziam ainda oferta voluntária cada manhã.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ כָּל־הַ֣חֲכָמִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֕ים אֵ֖ת כָּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אִֽישׁ־אִ֥ישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which they did.
controles.kjv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
controles.livre: Vieram, portanto, todos os mestres que faziam toda a obra do santuário, cada um da obra que fazia.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה לֵּאמֹ֔ר מַרְבִּ֥ים הָעָ֖ם לְהָבִ֑יא מִדֵּ֤י הָֽעֲבֹדָה֙ לַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”
controles.kjv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the Lord commanded to make.
controles.livre: E falaram a Moisés, dizendo: O povo traz muito mais do que é necessário para o trabalho de fazer a obra que o SENHOR mandou que se faça.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַל־יַעֲשׂוּ־ע֛וֹד מְלָאכָ֖ה לִתְרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א הָעָ֖ם מֵהָבִֽיא׃

controles.web: Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
controles.livre: Então Moisés mandou apregoar pelo acampamento, dizendo: Nenhum homem nem mulher faça mais obra para oferecer para o santuário. E assim foi o povo impedido de oferecer;

versos.hebraico: וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַיָּ֛ם לְכָל־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֹתָ֑הּ וְהוֹתֵֽר׃ס

controles.web: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
controles.kjv: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
controles.livre: Pois tinha material abundante para fazer toda a obra, e sobrava.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ כָל־חֲכַם־לֵ֜ב בְּעֹשֵׂ֧י הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, the work of the skillful workman, they made them.
controles.kjv: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
controles.livre: E todos os sábios de coração entre os que faziam a obra, fizeram o tabernáculo de dez cortinas, de linho torcido, e de material azul, e de púrpura e carmesim; as quais fizeram de obra prima, com querubins.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל־הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃

controles.web: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
controles.kjv: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
controles.livre: O comprimento da uma cortina era de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados: todas as cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחַבֵּר֙ אֶת־חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָ֑ת וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חִבַּ֔ר אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled one to another.
controles.kjv: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
controles.livre: E juntou as cinco cortinas a uma com a outra: também uniu as outras cinco cortinas uma com aa outra.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

controles.web: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
controles.kjv: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
controles.livre: E fez as laçadas de cor de material azul na orla de uma cortina, na margem, à juntura; e assim fez na orla à extremidade da segunda cortina, na juntura.

versos.hebraico: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite one to another.
controles.kjv: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
controles.livre: Cinquenta laçadas fez em um cortina, e outras cinquenta na segunda cortina, na margem, na juntura; umas laçadas em frente das outras.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֕עַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַיְחַבֵּ֨ר אֶת־הַיְרִעֹ֜ת אַחַ֤ת אֶל־אַחַת֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃ס

controles.web: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
controles.kjv: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
controles.livre: Fez também cinquenta colchetes de ouro, com os quais juntou as cortinas, uma com a outra; e fez-se um tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּֽי־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
controles.kjv: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
controles.livre: Fez também cortinas de pelo de cabras para a tenda sobre o tabernáculo, e as fez em número de onze.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת רֹ֖חַב הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃

controles.web: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
controles.kjv: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
controles.livre: O comprimento de uma cortina era de trinta côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados: as onze cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־חֲמֵ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְאֶת־שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָֽד׃

controles.web: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
controles.kjv: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
controles.livre: E juntou as cinco cortinas à parte, e as seis cortinas à parte.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ עַל־שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

controles.web: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
controles.kjv: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
controles.livre: Fez também cinquenta laçadas na orla da última cortina na juntura, e outras cinquenta laçadas na orla da outra cortina na juntura.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים לְחַבֵּ֥ר אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל לִֽהְיֹ֥ת אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: He made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
controles.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
controles.livre: Fez também cinquenta colchetes de bronze para juntar a tenda, de modo que fosse uma.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵלִ֖ים מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃ס

controles.web: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
controles.kjv: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.
controles.livre: E fez uma coberta para a tenda de couros vermelhos de carneiros, e uma coberta encima de couros finos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃

controles.web: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
controles.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
controles.livre: Também fez as tábuas para o tabernáculo de madeira de acácia, para estarem na vertical.

versos.hebraico: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמֹּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
controles.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
controles.livre: O comprimento de cada tábua de dez côvados, e de côvado e meio a largura.

versos.hebraico: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדֹ֗ת לַקֶּ֨רֶשׁ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: Each board had two tenons, joined one to another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
controles.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
controles.livre: Cada tábua tinha dois encaixes fixos um diante do outro: assim fez todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קְרָשִׁ֔ים לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גֶב תֵּימָֽנָה׃

controles.web: He made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side southward.
controles.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
controles.livre: Fez, pois, as tábuas para o tabernáculo: vinte tábuas ao lado do sul.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־כֶ֔סֶף עָשָׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
controles.kjv: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
controles.livre: Fez também as quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua para seus dois encaixes, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua para seus dois encaixes.

versos.hebraico: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עָשָׂ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים קְרָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,
controles.kjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
controles.livre: E para o outro lado do tabernáculo, à parte do norte, fez vinte tábuas,

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
controles.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
controles.livre: Com suas quarenta bases de prata: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua.

versos.hebraico: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה עָשָׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
controles.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
controles.livre: E para o lado ocidental do tabernáculo fez seis tábuas.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
controles.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
controles.livre: Para as esquinas do tabernáculo nos dois lados fez duas tábuas,

versos.hebraico: וְהָי֣וּ תוֹאֲמִם֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ אֶל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן עָשָׂ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֖י הַמִּקְצֹעֹֽת׃

controles.web: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
controles.kjv: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
controles.livre: As quais se juntavam por baixo, e também por cima a uma argola: e assim fez à uma e à outra nos dois cantos.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֤י אֲדָנִים֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: There were eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; under every board two sockets.
controles.kjv: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
controles.livre: Eram, pois, oito tábuas, e suas bases de prata dezesseis; duas bases debaixo de cada tábua.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּרִיחֵ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: He made bars of acacia wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
controles.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
controles.livre: Fez também as barras de madeira de acácia; cinco para as tábuas do um lado do tabernáculo,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה בְרִיחִם֙ לְקַרְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃

controles.web: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
controles.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
controles.livre: E cinco barras para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, e cinco barras para as tábuas do lado do tabernáculo à parte ocidental.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֑ן לִבְרֹ֨חַ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֔ים מִן־הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־הַקָּצֶֽה׃

controles.web: He made the middle bar to pass through in the midst of the boards from the one end to the other.
controles.kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
controles.livre: E fez que a barra do meio passasse por meio das tábuas do um extremo ao outro.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־טַבְּעֹתָם֙ עָשָׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold for places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
controles.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
controles.livre: E cobriu as tábuas de ouro, e fez de ouro os anéis delas por de onde passassem as barras: cobriu também de ouro as barras.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃

controles.web: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
controles.kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
controles.livre: Fez assim o véu de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, o qual fez com querubins de delicada obra.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֗הּ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַפֵּ֣ם זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וַיִּצֹ֣ק לָהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־כָֽסֶף׃

controles.web: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
controles.kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
controles.livre: E para ele fez quatro colunas de madeira de acácia; e cobriu-as de ouro, os capitéis das quais eram de ouro; e fez para elas quatro bases de prata de fundição.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃

controles.web: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
controles.kjv: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
controles.livre: Fez também o véu para a porta do tabernáculo, de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, obra de bordador;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדָ֤יו חֲמִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת־וָ֣וֵיהֶ֔ם וְצִפָּ֧ה רָאשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ

controles.web: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of brass.
controles.kjv: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
controles.livre: E suas cinco colunas com seus capitéis: e cobriu as cabeças delas e suas molduras de ouro: mas suas cinco bases as fez de bronze.
